person: Rhian Price, paramedic with Glanmor Ambulance Service, lives in Cardiff with her partner Kwame Asante (a teacher) and their two-year-old Efa; they share one car

mail.subject: Rota published – December block
mail.body: Hi Rhian, the rota for the December block is now live on the staff portal. Please check your shifts and raise any swap requests with your team leader within 7 days. Glanmor Rota Office

mail.subject: Entry confirmed – Taf Trail 10K
mail.body: Thanks for entering! The race is on Sunday in four weeks, starting at 09:00 from the boathouse at Llyn Bach. Your bib number will be emailed about 10 days before race day. Entry fee paid: £22.00.

mail.subject: Your car insurance renewal
mail.body: Your policy for the Corvane Lumo, registration CK19 RNT, renews automatically in 21 days. Renewal premium: £684.20 (last year £591.00). Named drivers: Rhian Price, Kwame Asante. Excess: £350. If you don't want to renew, call us before the renewal date.

mail.subject: Staff training day and November invoice
mail.body: Dear parents, a reminder that Tŷ Bach will be closed on Friday week for our staff training day. Our opening hours otherwise remain 07:30–18:00. The November invoice (£612.40 for Efa) will be collected by direct debit in 12 days. Diolch, Tŷ Bach Nursery

mail.subject: car next week
mail.body: Hey, I need the car Thursday next week for the Year 9 field trip. Leaving at 7, should be back about 6. Is that OK with your night shift? I can drop you at the station if I'm back in time. K x

mail.subject: Efa's 2-year review
mail.body: Dear Ms Price, Efa's two-year development review with health visitor Bethan Lloyd is booked for Wednesday next week at 10:30 in Room 4, first floor. Please bring her red book and allow 30 minutes.

mail.subject: my 30th!!
mail.body: OK it's happening! I've booked Y Gegin Las for Saturday week at 7:30. It's a set menu at £35 a head and they want a £10 deposit per person, so please send it to me by Friday (details in the group chat). Partners very welcome. Can't wait! F x

mail.subject: MOT booking confirmed
mail.body: Thank you for booking with Hadley & Sons. Your MOT for CK19 RNT is booked for 08:30 on Monday after next. Please drop the car off by 08:15 and leave the locking wheel nut in the glovebox. MOT fee: £54.85. If any repairs are needed we'll phone you before doing any work.

mail.subject: Tadpoles – Efa's booking
mail.body: Efa is booked onto Tadpoles (parent and toddler, 2–3 years) on Sundays at 09:15 for the rest of term. The term fee of £48.00 has been paid. Please make sure Efa wears a swim nappy; family changing is cubicles 10–14.

mail.subject: Questionnaire before Efa's review
mail.body: Hi Rhian, before you come in, could you fill in the Ages and Stages questionnaire in the parent portal? It takes about 15 minutes and helps us make the most of the appointment. Thanks, Bethan

mail.subject: swap?
mail.body: Hiya, any chance you'd swap your night shift a fortnight on Saturday for my day shift on the Tuesday after? It's my mam's 60th that weekend. I'll owe you big time. Callum

mail.subject: Your prescription is ready
mail.body: Your repeat prescription (2 items) is ready to collect from Bloomfield Pharmacy. We'll hold it for 14 days. Open Monday to Saturday, 09:00–18:00.

mail.subject: Your payslip is ready
mail.body: Your November payslip is now available on the staff portal. Net pay: £2,318.62, paid into your account today. This includes 14 hours of unsocial-hours enhancement.

mail.subject: Your October bill
mail.body: Your bill for October is £143.27. We'll collect this by direct debit in 10 days. Your account number is DE-0093318.

mail.subject: Your order receipt LS-20931
mail.body: Thanks for your order LS-20931: toddler wellies, size 6, red, £24.99. Free returns within 30 days.

mail.subject: deposits!!
mail.body: Friendly nudge: deposits are due today please! Still waiting on four of you. F

mail.subject: Re: swap?
mail.body: Legend! Gareth's signed it off, so you're on my Tuesday day shift and I'll cover your Saturday night. Diolch o galon. Callum

mail.subject: Sunday
mail.body: Lunch tomorrow as usual? Mam's doing lamb, come for 1. Also, Mam's birthday is a fortnight on Wednesday. She says no fuss, but we're thinking lunch at the garden centre café the Saturday after. Dad

mail.subject: Council tax – next instalment
mail.body: Dear Ms Price, your next council tax instalment of £186.00 is due in 12 days. You currently pay by card. Please quote reference CT-448190-7 when paying online or by phone.

mail.subject: babysitter for Ffion's
mail.body: Lowri says she can babysit next Saturday from 7 till midnight, £12 an hour. Her mum can drop her off but she'll need a lift home after. Shall I say yes? K

mail.subject: Annual leave balance
mail.body: You have 9 days of annual leave remaining in this leave year, which ends in four months. Requests for leave over Christmas and New Year must be submitted by the end of this month.

mail.subject: Training – Thursday week
mail.body: Hi Rhian, you're booked on the paediatric sepsis clinical update on Thursday week, 09:00–16:30 at the Training Centre. Bring your CPD log; lunch is provided and uniform isn't required. Gareth

mail.subject: Christmas
mail.body: Cariad, are you working Christmas Day this year? Dad wants to know whether to book a table at the Llew Coch for Boxing Day. Mam x

mail.subject: Your parcel is on its way
mail.body: Order PW-77120-3 (toddler car seat cover) will be delivered tomorrow between 11:00 and 13:00. Safe place: porch.

mail.subject: Appointment reminder
mail.body: This is a reminder of your check-up with Dr Okonjo on Friday week at 14:20. Please arrive 5 minutes early. Band 1 charge: £27.40.

mail.subject: Efa's week + parents' evening
mail.body: Efa's had a lovely week, she's obsessed with the sand tray! Parents' evening is Monday next week and I've put you down for the 17:30 slot (10 minutes). Could you also send in a spare set of clothes and more nappies? We're on size 5 now. Siân

mail.subject: Uniform order ready
mail.body: Your replacement boots (size 6) and two shirts are ready to collect from Stores at Nant Coch. Stores is open 08:00–15:00, Monday to Friday. Collection reference US-3381.

mail.subject: Thursday + Friday week
mail.body: Two things: can you do nursery pick-up Thursday week? I've got Year 11 parents' evening till 8. And I need the car Friday week for the moderation meeting, out by 7:30, back around 6. K

mail.subject: Your car insurance quote
mail.body: Quote SC-55021 for CK19 RNT: £612.50 a year, two named drivers, £250 excess. This quote is valid for 30 days.

mail.subject: playdate Saturday?
mail.body: Noor keeps asking for Efa! Saturday morning at Llwyn Onn playground, 10ish? If it rains we'll go to the café. Hana

mail.subject: Meter reading needed
mail.body: Please send us a meter reading within the next 5 days so your next bill isn't estimated.

mail.subject: Delivered
mail.body: Your parcel PW-77120-3 was delivered at 12:18 and left in the porch.

mail.subject: Noah's 3rd!
mail.body: You're invited to Noah's 3rd birthday party, a week on Saturday, 3–5pm at Funhouse soft play on Heol Isaf. Socks for grown-ups too! Let me know numbers by Friday. Precious

mail.subject: Saturday
mail.body: Hi Rhian! All good for Saturday, 7 till late. Does Efa still have her bunny at bedtime? My mum will drop me, so I just need a lift home. Lowri

mail.subject: tmrw
mail.body: Staff meeting till 5:30 tomorrow, can you grab Efa from nursery? Car's yours tomorrow, I'll bike in. K

mail.subject: Pre-reading for the sepsis update
mail.body: Hi all, please read the two attached case studies (the febrile infant and the 3-year-old with a non-blanching rash) before Thursday week's session. Nia

mail.subject: Overtime available
mail.body: Overtime available: day shift at Nant Coch on Saturday in 10 days, 07:00–19:00. Reply by Friday if you'd like it.

mail.subject: Teaching pool closed this Sunday
mail.body: Due to a maintenance issue the teaching pool will be closed this Sunday. Tadpoles will run in the main pool's shallow end at the usual time.

mail.subject: Room change today
mail.body: Today's health visitor clinics have moved to Room 2 on the ground floor while the lift is out of service.

mail.subject: Saturday – new time!
mail.body: The restaurant has moved us to 8pm because of a big booking before us. Same place. See you Saturday! F x
